description: OLE-PROP and the warning channel: on a read/write copy eight Recordsets are opened with requested (location, cursor type, lock type, options) combinations, including conflicting ones (forward-only with batch optimistic or pessimistic, client batch, adCmdTableDirect keyset). For each: State, effective CursorType, LockType and CursorLocation, the Supports options, the whole Recordset.Properties inventory (Name, Type, Value, Attributes), then the Connection Errors, which are cleared. Asks the effective rowset properties for each request and whether a downgrade is reported as an Errors entry.
